editorial:
Colonel Dale Murphy runs a fake survival reality show in the West Virginia woods, and you watch contestants try to act tough while the cameras roll. The fun setup quickly turns nasty when the inbred cannibal family starts picking them off. You get a mix of reality-TV jokes, gross-out horror, and fast action, so the movie never feels too serious. The contestants are easy to root for or laugh at, and Henry Rollins as Murphy brings big energy that keeps things lively.

The action is loud and messy, with plenty of blood and chase scenes, but the pacing stays quick enough to keep you entertained. Some jokes land, some characters are thin, and the gore is definitely not for everyone. If you like wild horror sequels and don't mind cheesy moments, this is a fun pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Murphy breaks free and fights back, taking down several cannibals, but the family keeps coming. Nina and Jake make it out of the woods after a brutal last stand, while the surviving cannibals are left behind. The last beat suggests the nightmare isn't over, hinting that at least one cannibal is still out there. You are left with the feeling that the family hunt will continue.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves wild horror sequels and dark comedy.
